subject: Lighthouse — budget check & partner discount options
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Nolan <kate@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-15 13:08 PDT
Subject: Re: Lighthouse discovery — quick recap and next steps

Hi Kate — great to meet you and the Lighthouse team this morning. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on so we have a clear next step path: 

Call summary:
- Product fit: you want to embed summarization + Q&A across web and mobile; mostly batched generation for nightly index jobs and low-latency interactive for chat.
- Current signal: pilot traffic ~150M tokens/month, expecting to ramp toward ~1.2B tokens/month over 6–9 months if performance and unit cost align.
- Constraints: procurement requires a formal quote and simple SOW; security checklist is underway with your security team.

Immediate asks from us:
1) Can you confirm a 1–12 month budget range you’re comfortable with for inference (ballpark $/month)? even a two-line range helps us align options.
2) Target $/1M tokens target you mentioned on the call — you said a ballpark number; please confirm the target threshold (e.g. <$800 / 1M tokens).
3) Any firm preference for a 12-month committed path vs shorter-term reserved blocks?

What we’ll deliver by EOD tomorrow:
- Two pricing scenarios (startup-friendly path + committed-use discounts) with unit economics and estimated monthly spend for your ramp profile.
- A simple burn/workbook we can drop into your model (xlsx).

Attachments: I’ll include a lightweight workbook and our startup terms for reference. If that looks right we can schedule a 30-min pricing walkthrough with Ben (SE) to lock in the right tier.

Best,
Tessa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | https://redwood.ai

(Attachment stub: Redwood_Startup_Terms.pdf)

From: Kate Nolan <kate@lighthouse.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@lighthouse.ai>
Date: 2027-08-15 13:45 PDT
Subject: Re: Lighthouse discovery — quick recap and next steps

Thanks Tessa — nice summary. Quick clarifications: 

1) Budget range: For the next 3 months we can commit to $9k–$18k / month depending on unit price and performance. If the numbers look good we have approval to expand to ~$70k / month by month 6 (staged ramp).
2) Target unit cost: ideally we want to keep total inference spend at or below $800 / 1M tokens; if we can get to $600 / 1M with a committed path that would be attractive.
3) Commitment horizon: prefer a 12-month committed structure for price predictability, but open to a 6-month ramp + committed baseline if that reduces upfront risk.

Procurement note: please include a simple one-page terms addendum for startup credits (we are seed-stage; YC alum). Also send anything legal needs to see re: payment terms and data handling.

Would appreciate the two scenarios you mentioned. We can do a quick call tomorrow afternoon after our internal sync; otherwise Wednesday morning PST works.

—Kate
Co-founder & Head of Product | Lighthouse Inc.
(Attachment: 1-pager procurement constraints.pdf referenced)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Nolan <kate@lighthouse.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-16 09:12 PDT
Subject: Re: Lighthouse discovery — quick recap and next steps

Kate / Tessa — following up with concrete unit economics and two scenario sketches based on the ramp you described. I’m including inline assumptions and the workbook (Redwood_Pricing_Workbook.xlsx).

Quick assumptions (please flag if any differ):
- Baseline public hosted rate (no commit): $1,200 / 1M tokens (inference generation heavy workloads).
- Volume tiers (examples):
  * 0–250M / mo: $1,000 / 1M
  * 250–750M / mo: $800 / 1M
  * 750M+ / mo: $650 / 1M
- Committed-use discounts (12-month):
  * Modest commit (avg 300M/mo): effective $700 / 1M + 5% rebate for year 2
  * Aggressive commit (avg 800M/mo): effective $550 / 1M + multi-year rebate 8–12% if renews year 2

Scenario A — Low-risk, 6-mo ramp -> 12-mo baseline
- Months 1–3: pilot at 150M/mo at $1,000 / 1M = ~$150/mo * 150 = ~$150k (see workbook for formulas).
- Commit months 4–12: baseline 300M/mo at committed rate $700 / 1M -> ~$210k / month.
- Expected blended unit: ~$760 / 1M over year 1.

Scenario B — Committed 12-month (favorable unit economics)
- Commit upfront to average 600–800M/mo for 12 months.
- Negotiated effective $550–$600 / 1M depending on final band and multi-year rebate schedule.
- Upfront billing options: monthly invoiced vs net-30 with an initial deposit (we can be flexible).

Startup program note: as a seed-stage company (YC alumni), Lighthouse may qualify for a one-time founders credit that effectively reduces year-1 spend by a fixed amount. I attached the Startup Terms PDF; qualifying is typically administrative (company docs + short eligibility form).

Next steps I suggest: 
- You drop your projected month-by-month token burn into the attached Lighthouse_Burn_Model.xlsx and return it; I’ll populate line-item monthly spend and show exact blended $/1M results.
- Schedule a 30-min pricing walkthrough: I have slots tomorrow 3–4pm PT or Wednesday 9–11am PT.

Links: Pricing workbook attached and live copy here: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/:x:/r/sales/pricing/Redwood_Pricing_Workbook.xlsx

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment stubs: Redwood_Pricing_Workbook.xlsx, Lighthouse_Burn_Model.xlsx, Redwood_Startup_Terms.pdf)

1) I’ll populate the burn model and return it by EOD tomorrow.
2) We’d like a formal quote that includes:

Best,
Kate
